outcome: Admission to NICU for 24 hr or more
cohort: 1500 pregnant women at high risk of pre-eclampsia (with hypertension), randomized into folic acid and placebo groups.
finding: High-dose folic acid supplementation significantly reduced the incidence of pre-eclampsia (5.3% vs 10%) and secondary outcomes compared to placebo in pregnant women with hypertension.
gest_age: Enrolled between 8 to 16 complete weeks of gestation
